verses.original: אֶעֱמֹ֔דָה עַל־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י וְאֶֽתְיַצְּבָ֖ה עַל־ מָצ֑וֹר וַאֲצַפֶּ֗ה לִרְאוֹת֙ מַה־ יְדַבֶּר־ בִּ֔י וּמָ֥ה אָשִׁ֖יב עַל־ תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·‘ĕ·mō·ḏāh ‘al- miš·mar·tî wə·’eṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇāh ‘al- mā·ṣō·wr wa·’ă·ṣap·peh lir·’ō·wṯ mah- yə·ḏab·ber- bî ū·māh ’ā·šîḇ ‘al- tō·w·ḵaḥ·tî
verses.literal: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts I will watch to see what He will say to me and how I should answer when corrected

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר וַיַּעֲנֵ֤נִי כְּת֣וֹב חָז֔וֹן וּבָאֵ֖ר עַל־ הַלֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן ק֥וֹרֵא יָר֖וּץ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî kə·ṯō·wḇ ḥā·zō·wn ū·ḇā·’êr ‘al- hal·lu·ḥō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an qō·w·rê yā·rūṣ ḇōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . answered me Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets so that a herald may run with it

verses.original: כִּ֣י חָזוֹן֙ ע֤וֹד לַמּוֹעֵ֔ד וְיָפֵ֥חַ לַקֵּ֖ץ וְלֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם־ יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה־ ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־ בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א לֹ֥א יְאַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥā·zō·wn ‘ō·wḏ lam·mō·w·‘êḏ wə·yā·p̄ê·aḥ laq·qêṣ wə·lō yə·ḵaz·zêḇ ’im- yiṯ·mah·māh ḥak·kêh- lōw kî- ḇō yā·ḇō lō yə·’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: For the vision awaits an appointed time it testifies of the end and does not lie Though it lingers wait for it since it will surely come . . . and will not delay

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה עֻפְּלָ֔ה נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בּ֑וֹ לֹא־ יָשְׁרָ֥ה וְצַדִּ֖יק יִחְיֶֽה׃ בֶּאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘up·pə·lāh nap̄·šōw bōw lō- yā·šə·rāh wə·ṣad·dîq yiḥ·yeh be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Look at the proud one his soul . . . is not upright but the righteous will live by faith

verses.original: הַיַּ֣יִן וְאַף֙ כִּֽי־ בּוֹגֵ֔ד יָהִ֖יר גֶּ֥בֶר וְלֹ֣א יִנְוֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הִרְחִ֨יב נַפְשׁ֗וֹ כִּשְׁא֜וֹל כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ וְה֤וּא וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔ע וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֵלָיו֙ וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ץ כָּל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃ אֵלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: hay·ya·yin wə·’ap̄ kî- bō·w·ḡêḏ yā·hîr ge·ḇer wə·lō yin·weh ’ă·šer hir·ḥîḇ nap̄·šōw kiš·’ō·wl ḵam·mā·weṯ wə·hū wə·lō yiś·bā‘ way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ’ê·lāw way·yiq·bōṣ kāl- hā·‘am·mîm ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: and wealth indeed . . . betrays him [He is] an arrogant man never at rest He enlarges his appetite like Sheol and like Death he is never satisfied He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־ כֻלָּ֗ם אֵ֣לֶּה יִשָּׂ֔אוּ מָשָׁ֣ל עָלָיו֙ ל֑וֹ וְיֹאמַ֗ר וּמְלִיצָ֖ה חִיד֣וֹת ה֚וֹי הַמַּרְבֶּ֣ה לֹּא־ ל֔וֹ וּמַכְבִּ֥יד עָלָ֖יו עַבְטִֽיט׃ עַד־ מָתַ֕י
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- ḵul·lām ’êl·leh yiś·śā·’ū mā·šāl ‘ā·lāw lōw wə·yō·mar ū·mə·lî·ṣāh ḥî·ḏō·wṯ hō·w ham·mar·beh lō- lōw ū·maḵ·bîḏ ‘ā·lāw ‘aḇ·ṭîṭ ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay
verses.literal: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him - speaking with mockery and derision Woe to him who amasses what is not his - and makes himself rich - with many loans How long will this go on

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא נֹשְׁכֶ֔יךָ פֶ֗תַע יָק֙וּמוּ֙ מְזַעְזְעֶ֑יךָ וְיִקְצ֖וּ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִמְשִׁסּ֖וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w nō·šə·ḵe·ḵā p̄e·ṯa‘ yā·qū·mū mə·za‘·zə·‘e·ḵā wə·yiq·ṣū wə·hā·yî·ṯā lim·šis·sō·wṯ lā·mōw
verses.literal: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken Then you will become their prey

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה שַׁלּ֙וֹתָ֙ רַבִּ֔ים גּוֹיִ֣ם כָּל־ יֶ֣תֶר עַמִּ֑ים יְשָׁלּ֖וּךָ מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־ אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kī ’at·tāh šal·lō·w·ṯā rab·bîm gō·w·yim kāl- ye·ṯer ‘am·mîm yə·šāl·lū·ḵā mid·də·mê ’ā·ḏām wa·ḥă·mas- ’e·reṣ qir·yāh wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: Because you have plundered many nations vvv the remnant of the people will plunder you because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land the city and all their dwellers . . .

verses.original: ה֗וֹי בֹּצֵ֛עַ לְבֵית֑וֹ רָ֖ע בֶּ֥צַע לָשׂ֤וּם קִנּ֔וֹ בַּמָּרוֹם֙ לְהִנָּצֵ֖ל מִכַּף־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w bō·ṣê·a‘ lə·ḇê·ṯōw rā‘ be·ṣa‘ lā·śūm qin·nōw bam·mā·rō·wm lə·hin·nā·ṣêl mik·kap̄- rā‘
verses.literal: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain to place his nest on high [and] escape the hand of disaster

verses.original: יָעַ֥צְתָּ בֹּ֖שֶׁת לְבֵיתֶ֑ךָ קְצוֹת־ רַבִּ֖ים עַמִּ֥ים וְחוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·‘aṣ·tā bō·šeṯ lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā qə·ṣō·wṯ- rab·bîm ‘am·mîm wə·ḥō·w·ṭê nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life

verses.original: כִּי־ אֶ֖בֶן תִּזְעָ֑ק מִקִּ֣יר וְכָפִ֖יס יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ מֵעֵ֥ץ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’e·ḇen tiz·‘āq miq·qîr wə·ḵā·p̄îs ya·‘ă·nen·nāh mê·‘êṣ
verses.literal: For the stones will cry out from the wall and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork

verses.original: ה֛וֹי בֹּנֶ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּדָמִ֑ים וְכוֹנֵ֥ן קִרְיָ֖ה בְּעַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w bō·neh ‘îr bə·ḏā·mîm wə·ḵō·w·nên qir·yāh bə·‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְיִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּדֵי־ אֵ֔שׁ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים יִעָֽפוּ׃ בְּדֵי־ רִ֥יק
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w hin·nêh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·yî·ḡə·‘ū ‘am·mîm bə·ḏê- ’êš ū·lə·’um·mîm yi·‘ā·p̄ū bə·ḏê- rîq
verses.literal: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire and the nations weary themselves in vain

verses.original: כִּ֚י הָאָ֔רֶץ תִּמָּלֵ֣א לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה כַּמַּ֖יִם יְכַסּ֥וּ עַל־ יָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hā·’ā·reṣ tim·mā·lê lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh kam·ma·yim yə·ḵas·sū ‘al- yām
verses.literal: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover . . . the sea

verses.original: ה֚וֹי מַשְׁקֵ֣ה רֵעֵ֔הוּ מְסַפֵּ֥חַ חֲמָתְךָ֖ וְאַ֣ף שַׁכֵּ֑ר לְמַ֥עַן הַבִּ֖יט עַל־ מְעוֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w maš·qêh rê·‘ê·hū mə·sap·pê·aḥ ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā wə·’ap̄ šak·kêr lə·ma·‘an hab·bîṭ ‘al- mə·‘ō·w·rê·hem
verses.literal: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk in order to gaze at their nakedness

verses.original: שָׂבַ֤עְתָּ קָלוֹן֙ מִכָּב֔וֹד אַ֖תָּה גַם־ שְׁתֵ֥ה וְהֵֽעָרֵ֑ל כּ֚וֹס יְהוָ֔ה יְמִ֣ין תִּסּ֣וֹב עָלֶ֗יךָ וְקִיקָל֖וֹן עַל־ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ḇa‘·tā qā·lō·wn mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ ’at·tāh ḡam- šə·ṯêh wə·hê·‘ā·rêl kō·ws Yah·weh yə·mîn tis·sō·wḇ ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·qî·qā·lō·wn ‘al- kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be filled with shame instead of glory You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you and utter disgrace . . . will cover your glory

verses.original: כִּ֣י חֲמַ֤ס לְבָנוֹן֙ יְכַסֶּ֔ךָּ וְשֹׁ֥ד בְּהֵמ֖וֹת יְחִיתַ֑ן מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־ אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḥă·mas lə·ḇā·nō·wn yə·ḵas·se·kā wə·šōḏ bə·hê·mō·wṯ yə·ḥî·ṯan mid·də·mê ’ā·ḏām wa·ḥă·mas- ’e·reṣ qir·yāh wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you and the destruction of animals will terrify you because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land the city and all their dwellers . . .

verses.original: מָֽה־ הוֹעִ֣יל פֶּ֗סֶל כִּ֤י יֹֽצְר֔וֹ פְסָלוֹ֙ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וּמ֣וֹרֶה שָּׁ֑קֶר כִּ֣י יֹצֵ֤ר בָטַ֞ח יִצְרוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֱלִילִ֥ים אִלְּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: māh- hō·w·‘îl pe·sel kî yō·ṣə·rōw p̄ə·sā·lōw mas·sê·ḵāh ū·mō·w·reh šā·qer kî yō·ṣêr ḇā·ṭaḥ yiṣ·rōw ‘ā·lāw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ĕ·lî·lîm ’il·lə·mîm
verses.literal: What use is an idol that a craftsman should carve it [or] an image a teacher of lies For its maker trusts in his own creation . . . he makes idols that cannot speak

verses.original: ה֣וֹי אֹמֵ֤ר לָעֵץ֙ הָקִ֔יצָה דּוּמָ֑ם לְאֶ֣בֶן ע֖וּרִי ה֣וּא יוֹרֶ֔ה הִנֵּה־ ה֗וּא תָּפוּשׂ֙ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֔סֶף אֵ֥ין ר֖וּחַ בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃ וְכָל־
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’ō·mêr lā·‘êṣ hā·qî·ṣāh dū·mām lə·’e·ḇen ‘ū·rî hū yō·w·reh hin·nêh- hū tā·p̄ūś zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ’ên rū·aḥ bə·qir·bōw wə·ḵāl
verses.literal: Woe to him who says to wood Awake or to silent stone Arise Can it give guidance Behold it [is] overlaid with gold and silver yet there is no breath in it at all

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֖ה קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ הַ֥ס מִפָּנָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·ḏə·šōw bə·hê·ḵal kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ has mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: But the LORD is in His holy temple let all the earth be silent before Him
